data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH sent a final electricity bill (Schlussrechnung) after your move-out for the supply point at Lindenweg 12. The total is €105.58, due within 30 days of the invoice date of 14 April 2026.
data.explanation: This is the final bill for your electricity at your old address, covering 1 January to 31 March 2026. You used 212 kWh more than you had paid for in advance, so you owe the difference plus the base fee, including VAT. Pay €105.58 to the account shown by the deadline shown. If you think the amount is wrong, contact the Stadtwerke customer service. Keep the bill for your records.
